# Accent color (`theme.accent_color`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Personalization · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** yes

Sets the Windows accent color, and optionally shows it on Start/taskbar and title bars.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | text | yes |  | Color as #RRGGBB. Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `show_on_taskbar` | true / false | no |  | Show the accent color on Start and the taskbar. |
| `show_on_title_bars` | true / false | no |  | Show the accent color on title bars and window borders. |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: theme.accent_color
    color: "#E11D48"
    show_on_title_bars: true
```

## In profiles

When this action is part of a [profile](../../guide/profiles.md), the current value is saved before it runs and
restored when the profile is reverted.

## Notes

Quote the color in YAML ("#E11D48"), because # starts a comment. Also turns off 'automatically pick an accent color from my background'.
